chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Allah has taken a pledge from the believer that his words will be belied and that he would not be able to avenge himself against his enemy.

key_terms.يُنْتَصَفَ: to be avenged or given one's due right

ai.seo_question: What is the pledge Allah took from the believer regarding their words and enemies?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the spiritual condition of the believer, stating that Allah has taken a pledge that the believer's words will often be disbelieved or rejected, and that they will not be able to fully avenge themselves against their enemies. It highlights the trials of status and justice that believers endure.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 38. It has been narrated that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:
Allah has taken a pledge from the believer that his words will be belied and that he would not be able to avenge himself against his enemy.
